name: servicenow
description: Call the tools your admin publishes on a ServiceNow instance.

SERVICENOW_HOST.title: Instance hostname
SERVICENOW_HOST.description: Bare hostname of the ServiceNow instance, for example acme.service-now.com. Leave out https:// and any path.

SERVICENOW_MCP_SERVER.title: MCP server name
SERVICENOW_MCP_SERVER.description: Name from the server record in MCP Server Console. This is the last segment of the Server URL. The preconfigured Quickstart Server is sn_mcp_server_default.

CLIENT_ID.title: OAuth client ID
CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID from the OAuth inbound integration created for this client in Machine Identity Console.

CLIENT_SECRET.title: OAuth client secret
CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret from the same OAuth inbound integration. Stored encrypted and never shown back.
